== English errata comparison sources ==
Decipher adds the deploy-phase restriction to the free TIE Assault Squadron branch. The initiated Cloud City sector battle-destiny branch and lack of a replacement requirement are unchanged.

Decipher, [[Media:Decipher Glossary 1998.pdf#page=16|Glossary Version 2.0]], November 1998, PDF page 16. Players Committee, Decipher Errata, official text as of 1 January 2013, PDF page 10. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20160809094140id_/http://www.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/DecipherErrata.pdf#page=10 Internet Archive]. Players Committee, [[Media:PC-Decipher-Errata-June-2017.pdf#page=9|Decipher Errata]], official text as of June 2017, PDF page 9. Players Committee, [[Media:SWCCG 2023 AdvancedRulebook.pdf#page=104|2023 Advanced Rulebook]], Appendix A, PDF page 104. [[:File:CC-D-atmosphericassault.gif|Complete replacement face]]. The original Wiki identifier 5_131o remains documented, while the explicit GEMP display is blank because the pinned Guild directory and alias file do not supply that state.
